description: One insert of a 8156-byte Long Binary value into Lo (ID 100) through a table recordset. Asks where the single-page / chained form change and page-multiple boundaries fall for this size and which pages the value takes. Lo: six rows (ID, Long Binary O): row 1 Null; row 2 with 4076 bytes; row 3 with 4090 bytes; rows 10, 11 and 12 with 100 bytes each. Bytes are patterned (index * 7 + seed, modulo 256). ID and FieldSize are read back. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
